title: projectTests
responsibility: Plan initial app screenshot fixtures and library example cases.

outputs.name: appTestFiles
outputs.description: Shared console and screenshot fixtures plus the initial page state at desktop 1440x900, tablet 920x800 and mobile 390x844. Each case navigates to / and matches the full page against its own reviewed baseline; missing or changed baselines fail.

outputs.description: A registered initial library example and strict registry. Its Vitest runner records observed outcomes under canonical snapshot paths; verification links installed dependencies.
